alerts.title: John Henry Kirby Mansion
alerts.severity_label: Critical Alert: Sewer Disconnection + Asbestos Abatement
alerts.headline: Multi-agency redevelopment alert: COH Sewer Disconnect (#26090093) & DSHS Asbestos Abatement (#2026005825, Oct 27 - Nov 6, 2026) at 2000 Smith St + TDLR TABS (#TABS2026022839, $2M 13,254 SF 'Braketime' C-Store) & COH Gas Station Plan Review (#26052089) at perimeter address 530 Pierce St.
alerts.preservation_note: Built in 1894 for businessman J.S. Price and purchased by lumber magnate John Henry Kirby in 1896, the 36-room Tudor Revival mansion at 2000 Smith Street achieved its landmark appearance in a 1928 remodeling designed by architect James Ruskin Bailey (1979 Preservation Houston Good Brick Award). Cross-agency monitoring by Preservation Houston across both 2000 Smith St and perimeter block address 530 Pierce St uncovered an 8-stage redevelopment sequence: (1) Oct 2025 formation of Smith St C Store LLC and Active Sales Tax Permit #32102472084 for 'Brake Time'; (2) Apr 1, 2026 TABC liquor permit and DSHS Hemp registration; (3) May 28, 2026 Planning Commission approval of the 'Smith Street Plaza' replat into 1 unrestricted reserve; (4) June 17, 2026 TDLR Architectural Barriers registration #TABS2026022839 at 530 Pierce St for 'Braketime Smith Road' ($2,000,000, 13,254 SF convenience store designed by Heights Engineering); (5) June 24, 2026 COH Plan Review #26052089 at 530 Pierce St for a proposed gas station (submitted 8 times, returned Oct 2, 2026); (6) Sept 30 / Oct 1, 2026 Special Warranty Deed #RP-2026-399473 transferring the block to OB Texas Properties LLC (Omair Bashir) with a $7M loan from Greenberg Finance Co.; (7) Oct 13, 2026 DSHS Notification #2026005825 scheduling abatement of 5,010 SF of RACM from Oct 27 to Nov 6, 2026; and (8) Oct 14, 2026 COH Permit #26090093 ('BLD DEMO/SEWER DISC').

dshs_notifications.work_description: Removal of asbestos containing white woven cloth, aircell pipe insulation, parapet, & wallboard utilizing wet methods, negative pressure, regulated area and air monitoring. Exterior window caulking removed utilizing open air methods. All ACM will be packaged and disposed of in accordance with applicable rules and regulations.

multi_agency_filings.summary: Plumbing permit for 'BLD DEMO/SEWER DISC' (occupant '*KIRBY MANSION') issued to contractor Robert Camacho.
Full-containment abatement of 5,010 SF RACM and 150 LF pipe insulation scheduled Oct 27 - Nov 6, 2026 by AAR Incorporated for owner Omair Bashir.

multi_agency_filings.type: Special Warranty Deed & $7M Deed of Trust
multi_agency_filings.summary: Sale closed 9/30/2026 from Hi Tech Auto Realty LLC to OB Texas Properties LLC (Omair Bashir), financed by a $7,000,000 loan from Greenberg Finance Co.
Building plans for a proposed gas station submitted under perimeter address 530 Pierce St; submitted 8 times and returned for revisions on Oct 2, 2026.
'Braketime Smith Road': $2,000,000 new construction of a 13,254 SF convenience store (scheduled 9/1/2026 - 9/1/2027), designed by Heights Engineering for tenant Brake Time.
Planning Commission approved replat consolidating the entire 62,500 SF block into 1 unrestricted reserve (not yet recorded with County Clerk).
TABC Wine and Malt Beverage Retailer's Off-Premise Permit (BQ) issued 4/1/2026 following Feb-Mar 2026 legal notices; DSHS Retail Hemp Registration filed.

alerts.title: 2101 NASA PKY
alerts.severity_label: Active Watch: Texas DSHS Abatement Filing
alerts.headline: Texas DSHS abatement notification (#2026004028) scheduled 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-19.

dshs_notifications.work_description: 1)Description of procedures to be followed in the event that unexpected asbestos is found or previously non-friable asbestos material becomes crumbled, pulverized, or reduced to powder: work will be stopped until an asbestos survey can be performed to confirm or deny the presence of asbestos 2)Description of planned demolition or abatement work, type of material, and method(s) to be used: 800 spot scrapes (approximately 0.25 sqft each) of spray applied fireproofing to be performed throughout building for the installation of new pipes, ducts and conduit. Abatement to be performed in negative pressure enclosures with a two stage decon and remote shower. Fireproofing to be adequately wet prior to removal. All waste to be disposed of as asbestos containing.

1) If unexpected asbestos containing materials are encountered, the work will immediately cease. The area will be misted with water, and the Asbestos Supervisor will notify the owner's and prime contractor's representatives for additional instructions. 2) The regulated asbestos containing material is primarily pipe insulation or other thermal system insulation. Piping consists of insulated piping and mudded elbows and associated fittings. Negative pressure containment and wet removal methods will be used for removal of TSI from piping and surface of a small tank. 3) To prevent migration of asbestos fibers from the work area, glove bags and negative pressure enclosures will be utilized. Poly containmnets will be constructed and poly sheeting will be use to wrap any remaining TSI on piping or small tank. Continuous negative pressure enclosures will be used during abatement activities, and clearance monitoring in the immediate work area will be performed following decontamination of enclosure. Waste will be double bagged, goose-necked, and labeled; the waste will be placed into a dedicated rolloff and manifested/transported to a permitted asbestos waste disposal site.
